def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Identify a full uniform separator row or column dividing equal panels.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row))==1 and r>0 and r<h-1 and r==(h-1)//2:
            top,bottom=grid[:r],grid[r+1:]
            return [[2 if top[i][j]!=0 and bottom[i][j]!=0 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(top))]
    for c in range(w):
        col=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col))==1 and c>0 and c<w-1 and c==(w-1)//2:
            left=[row[:c] for row in grid]
            right=[row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if left[i][j]!=0 and right[i][j]!=0 else 0 for j in range(len(left[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('separator not found')
